name: joplin-plugin-excalidraw
description: Excalidraw drawings in your notes: create and edit hand-drawn sketches, diagrams and whiteboards without leaving Joplin, with light and dark theme support and editing straight from the editor. Continuation of joplin-excalidraw-v2 (neagix) and joplin-excalidraw (artikell).
author: pmslava

scripts.dist: export NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider && webpack --joplin-plugin-config buildMain && npm run dist:webview && npm run dist:local && webpack --joplin-plugin-config buildExtraScripts && webpack --joplin-plugin-config createArchive
